command: llvm-mc -triple=riscv64 -filetype=obj research/evidence/experiments/EXP-0098/pair.asm -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input (LF, trailing newline): `  .text` / `  lui a0, %hi(blob)` / `  addi a0, a0, %lo(blob)`. The object bytes are `37 05 00 00 13 05 05 00`; both fields are zero because the symbol is external, which is exactly what `emit_relocation` writes. `llvm-readobj --relocations` reports `R_RISCV_HI20 blob` at 0x0 and `R_RISCV_LO12_I blob` at 0x4. The plan uses `pc_reference_rule = none` for both members: `%hi`/`%lo` name the absolute `S + A`, not a PC-relative displacement, and the low half masks the same absolute value.
source: measured relocation names and offsets from `llvm-readobj --relocations`; RISC-V UDB `inst/I/lui.yaml` for the `imm` field at 31-12
